arxiv-2308-15348.title: Muon precession from the aspect of Dirac equations
arxiv-2308-15348.creator: Jinbo He, Lei Ming, Yi-Lei Tang, Qiankang Wang, Hong-Hao Zhang
arxiv-2308-15348.description: Abstract In this paper, we would like to compute the muon anomalous precession frequency through solving the wave functions of the Dirac equations straightforwardly. The precession of a (anti-)muon with an anomalous magnetic momentum term is calculated together with the quantum corrections.

arxiv-2410-07866.title: System 2 Reasoning via Generality and Adaptation
arxiv-2410-07866.creator: Sejin Kim, Sundong Kim, sundong@gist.ac.kr
arxiv-2410-07866.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sejin Kim, Sundong Kim, sundong@gist.ac.kr. While significant progress has been made in task-specific applications, current models struggle with deep reasoning, generality, and adaptation—key components of System 2 reasoning that are crucial for achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Despite the promise of approaches such as program synthesis, language models, and transformers, these methods often fail to generalize beyond their training data and to adapt to novel tasks, limiting their ability to perform human-like reasoning.

arxiv-2501-10520.title: On the tame isotropy group of a derivation
arxiv-2501-10520.creator: Angelo Bianchi, Adriana Freitas and Marcelo Veloso
arxiv-2501-10520.description: Abstract . We introduce the tame isotropy group of a derivation of a polynomial ring . We study this group for certain triangular derivations up to three variables, for simple derivations in two variables, and for simple Shamsuddin derivations in any polynomial ring. Keywords: Derivation, (Tame) isotropy group, Automorphism Group. 2020 AMS MSC: 13N15, 16W20 13A50.

arxiv-2512-10119.description: Abstract The critical current of superconductors is commonly measured by testing unloaded wires under an external magnetic field. While stressed by intense Lorentz forces, the existing HTS/LTS superconductors are prone to a reduction in critical current before reaching their structural mechanical limit.

arxiv-2601-19843.title: Graphical X Splatting (GraphiXS): A Graphical Model for 4D Gaussian Splatting under Uncertainty 439 CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning approaches CCS: Computing methodologies Rendering
arxiv-2601-19843.creator: Doğa Yılmaz, Jialin Zhu, Deshan Gong, He Wang
arxiv-2601-19843.description: Abstract . We propose a new framework to systematically incorporate data uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting. Being the new paradigm of neural rendering, Gaussian Splatting has been investigated in many applications, with the main effort in extending its representation, improving its optimization process, and accelerating its speed. However, one orthogonal, much needed, but under-explored area is data uncertainty.

arxiv-2601-21408.title: MPF-Net: Exposing High-Fidelity AI-Generated Video Forgeries via Hierarchical Manifold Deviation and Micro-Temporal Fluctuations
arxiv-2601-21408.creator: Xinan He, Kaiqing Lin, Yue Zhou, Jiaming Zhong, Wei Ye, Wenhui Yi, Bing Fan, Feng Ding, Haodong Li, Bo Cao, Bin Li
arxiv-2601-21408.description: Abstract With the rapid advancement of video generation models such as Veo and Wan, the visual quality of synthetic content has reached a level where macro-level semantic errors and temporal inconsistencies are no longer prominent. However, this does not imply that the distinction between real and cutting-edge high-fidelity fake is untraceable.

pmc-11492871.description: Background: Adipocytes play a crucial role in tissue regeneration, contributing to the restoration of damaged areas and modulating the inflammatory milieu. pmc-11516313.title: Proton-pump inhibitor use in older adults: Public vs. Private Prescribing in Portugal
pmc-11516313.creator: S Romano, A Teixeira Rodrigues, C Torre, J Perelman
pmc-11516313.description: BackgroundProton pump inhibitors (PPI) are frequently overprescribed, posing challenges to patients and healthcare systems. In Portugal, the publicly funded National Health Service (NHS) provides universal coverage and reimburses the cost of medications regardless of the prescription origin. If private practices may benefit from longer consultation times allowing better prescription, they do not face any incentive to avoid over-prescription.

pmc-12604194.title: Understanding gestational diabetes in Hong Kong: women’s needs, self-management challenges, and the potential of digital health solutions in culturally sensitive care
pmc-12604194.creator: Bronya Hi Kwan Luk, Polly Haixia Ma, William Wing Kuen Lam, Agnes Yuen Kwan Lai, Rosenna Wai Ming Chung
pmc-12604194.description: BackgroundGestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), defined as glucose intolerance first recognised during pregnancy, poses serious health risks to mothers and newborns. The alarmingly high GDM prevalence in Hong Kong (25.9%), which is double the global average, necessitates urgent examination of context-specific management challenges.

pmc-12622749.title: The threshold effect of a body shape index on phenotypic age acceleration in U.S. adults: Insights from NHANES 1999 to 2010
pmc-12622749.creator: Yu-Jie Li
pmc-12622749.description: This study examines the relationship between a body shape index (ABSI) and accelerated aging in a nationally representative U.S. population. Data from the 1999 to 2010 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey were analyzed. ABSI numerically equals to waist circumference divided by the square of height and two-thirds power of body mass index.

pmc-12705789.title: Preoperative relugolix combination therapy in laparoscopic myomectomy: a case series evaluating impact on surgical planes and operative outcomes
pmc-12705789.creator: Brooke Vandermolen, Maxine Reindorf, Rebecca McMurray, Mehrnoosh Aref-Adib, Funlayo Odejinmi
pmc-12705789.description: IntroductionGonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) receptor antagonists in combination therapy offer a promising advancement in the medical management of uterine fibroids. While effective for symptom control, limited data exist on their impact on surgical outcomes, particularly during laparoscopic myomectomy. This case series describes the surgical findings in three patients who received preoperative Relugolix combination therapy (Relugolix–CT: relugolix–estradiol–norethisterone acetate) compared to no pretreatment.

pmc-13362031.title: Dynamics of Extracellular Traps in Vaginal Dysbiosis Associated with Gardnerella vaginalis: Ex Vivo Evidence from Neutrophils and Monocytes
pmc-13362031.creator: Aurora Prado-Sanhueza, Angélica Melo, Isabel Iturrieta-González, Pablo Navarro, Fabiola Zambrano
pmc-13362031.description: Vaginal dysbiosis, particularly bacterial vaginosis (BV), is associated with altered immune responses that may influence the formation of extracellular traps (ETs). This study aimed to characterize neutrophil and macrophage extracellular traps (NETs and METs) in vaginal discharge samples obtained from women with normal microbiota (NM) and BV, with particular emphasis on Gardnerella vaginalis (GV) detection.
